thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: autoscale.throttle_events spike in us-west-2 (service=inference, severity=page) — 1799 events in last 1m — paging oncall
Ava Chen: I'm on it, grabbing logs and dashboard.
Samir Patel: seeing high queue_depth on the inference pool too, queue_depth_p95 ~ 4200, tokens_per_sec cluster ~ 1.1x baseline.
Morgan Lee: paging handoff to @SRE Oncall — can someone confirm customer-facing impact?
Product Support: getting a couple customer reports of 503s for chat endpoints; looks correlated.
Ava Chen: confirmed 503 spikes on hosted API route /v1/chat/completions for a handful of tenants. throttles are up.
Ryan O'Neill: quick mitigation idea — enable burst_reserve for dedicated pools and raise min replicas temporarily. I'll run the command.
Samir Patel: do it, also flip fallback to smaller model variant for best-effort routing to reduce token/sec load.
Ryan O'Neill: running: `cictl pool update --name inference-usw2 --burst-reserve=enabled --min=12`
IncidentBot: Action recorded: burst_reserve enabled, min replicas increased from 6 -> 12.
Ava Chen: routing fallback enabled for model-family=llama-70b -> llama-13b-best-effort.
Morgan Lee: dashboards show queue depth dropping from 4200 -> 900 over last 3 mins. throttle_events/min dropping too.
Samir Patel: interim: adding a temporary rate-limiter for anonymous API keys to protect system while we stabilize.
Product Support: telling affected customers we mitigated and investigating root cause; will send update in 30m.
Ava Chen: root-cause hypothesis: sudden multi-tenant burst from a popular app + a recent rollout that increased token per request (stringified context). Need to validate with logs.
Ryan O'Neill: confirm there was a rollout in staging but not prod — hmm. Could be client-side change.
Morgan Lee: for post-incident, we need to tune alerts: current queue_depth alert pages on brief spikes. Suggest requiring sustained condition (for: 5m) and switch to p95 instead of instantaneous.
Samir Patel: agree. Propose new page rules: 
- High severity page: `sum(max_over_time(queue_depth[5m])) by (pool) > 1000 for 5m`
- Tokens/sec critical: `sum(rate(tokens_processed[1m])) by (pool) / pool_capacity > 0.85 for 3m`
- Throttle surge page: `increase(throttle_events[1m]) > 10` -> but only page if > 3m sustained or customer_error_rate > 0.5%
Ava Chen: add an alert for fallback routing usage too — if fallback_active_ratio > 0.2 for >2m, page oncall.
Morgan Lee: also add a low-noise notification (pager suppressed) for short bursts: `queue_depth_p95 > 2000` as an ops-signal (slack only).
Samir Patel: I'll open a PR with Prometheus alert rules and dashboard panels: throttle_events_per_min, queue_depth_p95_over_time, tokens_per_sec_normalized, fallback_usage_ratio, burst_reserve_utilization.
Ava Chen: runbook edits: emphasize two-tier paging: 1) sustained capacity saturation (page SRE), 2) transient bursts (notify, recommend autoscale tuning). Include checklist: enable burst_reserve, raise min replicas, enable model fallback, add temporary rate limit.
Ryan O'Neill: immediate follow-ups: (1) PR for alert rules (Samir), (2) new dashboard with panels and thresholds (Morgan), (3) runbook update + playbook snippets for burst_reserve and fallback (Ava), (4) customer comms thread (Product Support).
Samir Patel: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/inference/alerts/pull/458 — alert YAML attached and includes `for: 5m` on high severity rules.
Morgan Lee: dashboard draft posted in grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/inference/autoscale-mitigation — panels wired.
Ava Chen: post-incident notes: root cause likely client-side token inflation; engineering outreach to customers to advise on tokenization changes and optimal chunking.
Product Support: sending customer update now, will include mitigation steps and ask for sample payloads.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: autoscale.throttle_events spike mitigated by autoscale + fallback routing + temporary rate-limits — total duration ~ 27m — severity lowered to active-monitoring.
Ava Chen: closing timeline, will draft postmortem and link to PRs/dashboards.
Samir Patel: action item backlog: 1) implement new sustained alert rules (PR 458), 2) add alert suppressors for short bursts, 3) add per-tenant token-per-request heuristics to telemetry, 4) add automated recommendation to console to suggest min replica bump when sensed sustained >70% capacity.
Morgan Lee: thumbs up. tagging @SRE Oncall for handoff — I'm going offline, leave follow-ups to Samir/Ava. :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: acknowledged, taking follow-up ownership for open alerts and ensuring dashboard retention for 90d.
Ava Chen: thanks all — will post postmortem draft in #postmortems tomorrow.
